dog.description_text:
My #BoroughBreak Buddy Writes: Alpine is a wonderful, gentle dog with so much potential! She is a bit shy at first, but once you earn her trust, she will show your her zoomies-filled, playful, and affectionate side. One of her favorite things to do is to sit in the grass in the nice, warm sun. She loves people watching and cozying up next to her handler to share the moment. Once she became comfortable with me, she gave a lovely "hug" by resting her head gently on my shoulder as I gave her pets. She doesn't know tricks yet, but is treat motivated. Her leash manners are impeccable With other dogs, she can become anxious or impulsive. She is a bit nervous around men. She loves to play in water and will do little excited hops when she sees something she's interested in. Alpine would do great in an adult home with people that can see beyond anxiety and help her feel safe to show her true self.

Alpine arrived at MACC as a stray with no known history. While in care, Alpine has been observed to be fearful. Noted to have a tense body and flinch when handlers initiate contact. During their assessment, Alphine had a tense face and showed whale eye after the handler attempted to prt them. Due to the detailed behavior, we recommend an experienced adult only home.

I am a playgroup rockstar!
dog.name: Alpine
